fieldData.name: 113 University Place: What to Know About This Greenwich Village Address
fieldData.meta-description: 113 University Place is an 11-story loft building at the corner of University Place and 13th Street in Greenwich Village. Built in 1902, one block from Union Square.
fieldData.post-summary: 113 University Place is an 11-story commercial loft building at the southeast corner of University Place and East 13th Street in Greenwich Village, Manhattan. Built in 1902, the building contains approximately 57,739 square feet of office and commercial space.
